// diagnostic L0306

Jet.FloatInfinitySeedIntOnly

`{name}` is a Float seeded with {seed}, but every value assigned to it is an Int

What

`{name}` is a Float seeded with {seed}, but every value assigned to it is an Int

Why

Each Int widens to Float as it is assigned, so the result reads `5.0` where the input held `5`, and an Int beyond 2^53 stops the program

Fix

Make `{name}` an `Int?` that starts as `None`, or an Int that starts at `{bound}`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FloatInfinitySeedIntOnly: Tests/UI/float_infinity_seed_int_only.stderr.

    |     ^^^^
 Why: Each Int widens to Float as it is assigned, so the result reads `5.0` where the input held `5`, and an Int beyond 2^53 stops the program
 Fix: Make `best` an `Int?` that starts as `None`, or an Int that starts at `Int.MIN`
